singleSourced.context: The $49.99 Nano controller, Microsoft says, is designed with "younger players, smaller hands, or anyone seeking something portable for play on the go" in mind.
It offers all of the inputs of a regular-sized Xbox controller at nearly half the size and $15 cheaper.

It includes all 18 standard gameplay inputs, delivering a familiar controller layout players already love."

The Xbox Nano Controller is scheduled to release on November 4, 2026, and comes with two months of Xbox Game Pass Ultimate (limited to new members in the US only).
